meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析测序数据，生成可视化结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要做ChIP-seq、RNA-seq或ATAC-seq的数据处理与可视化
copy.tagline_en: Analyze NGS data and generate visualizations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to process and visualize ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, or ATAC-seq data

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你处理基因测序数据：把 BAM 文件转成 bigWig 格式、做质量控制（如相关性分析、PCA）、生成热图和谱图，用于 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 等实验的可视化。
howto.when: 当你提到“BAM 转 bigWig”、“质量控制”、“热图”、“谱图”等关键词，或要求分析 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 数据时触发。
howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process NGS data: convert BAM to bigWig, perform QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprint), and generate heatmaps/profiles for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'BAM to bigWig', 'QC', 'heatmap', 'profile', or request analysis of ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq data.

say_en.text: Use deepTools to convert sample.bam to bigWig with RPGC normalization.
Run plotFingerprint on these two BAM files to check ChIP enrichment.
say_en.note: Outputs fingerprint plot for quality assessment.

say_en.text: Use computeMatrix and plotHeatmap to create a heatmap around TSS.
say_en.note: Generates heatmap of signal around TSS.
